acceptancePolicy: No 50/50 target, old-rate equality, universal ally benefit or -20pp rejection
canonicalizationPolicy: Only slots and availableOnSlots arrays are semantic sets
confidencePolicy: Per-cell 95% Hoeffding of independent complete pair scores; not simultaneous
couplingCaveat: Added or removed members change IDs and random draws despite shared roots
durationPolicy: Round/action/turn distributions include completed battles only
finalAcceptancePolicy: Final only: equal-weight mean of 27 MAIN L10 win fractions>=.25, at least 2 tier means>=.20, no TIMEOUT/error; not a raw pooled percentage
scorePolicy: WIN=1 DRAW=0.5 LOSS=0; pair score averages its two dependent mirrors
seedPolicy: root + seedGroup * 1000 + pair; mirrors share seeds and use fresh actors
selectionPolicy: Screen only: largest C, MAIN wins>=135/540, 2 tiers>=36/180, no TIMEOUT/error
skillEventPolicy: Counts log events, not unique activations; source side plus separate event kind
timeoutPolicy: TIMEOUT is not LOSS; incomplete pairs omitted from paired scores
